# awscc_sagemaker_code_repository (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::SageMaker::CodeRepository



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `code_repository_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the code repository.
- `code_repository_name` (String) The name of the Git repository.
- `git_config` (Attributes) Configuration details for the Git repository, including the URL where it is located and the ARN of the AWS Secrets Manager secret that contains the credentials used to access the repository. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--git_config))
- `tags` (Attributes List) An array of key-value pairs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--git_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `git_config`

Read-Only:

- `branch` (String) The default branch for the Git repository.
- `repository_url` (String) The URL where the Git repository is located.
- `secret_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS Secrets Manager secret that contains the credentials used to access the git repository.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.
